ceramic_water_token.name: Ceramic Water-Token
ceramic_water_token.description: A palm-sized disc of fired clay, stamped with a mark you do not know. It is not money.
ceramic_water_token.lore: In the dunes coin is heavy and useless. A Djhanid carries his water-debts in clay: each token is a measure of water stored in a hidden deep well, and to them it is a life insurance policy. Someone lost the right to redeem this one.

bastion_ferry_token.name: Bastion Ferry Token
bastion_ferry_token.description: A heavy brass token stamped with a ship. One crossing from Sandcrest Landing to Thallia's Bastion, whenever the boat returns.
bastion_ferry_token.lore: The Northern Boat Route is only for the seasoned: Thallia's Bastion lies far north of the Landing, and the ship that serves it has not been seen in a long while. Keep the token safe.

compass.name: Compass
compass.description: A brass compass with a needle that never wavers from north. While you carry it, a compass shows the way you are facing. Press N to show or hide it.
compass.lore: The dunes shift and the roads vanish under the wind. Travelers who lose their bearings in the outskirts are rarely found. A compass is the cheapest insurance in Lumora.

brigand_cutlass.name: Notched Brigand Cutlass
brigand_cutlass.description: A curved blade nicked along its edge by more fights than its owner survived.

wardens_grave_blade.name: Warden's Grave-Blade
wardens_grave_blade.description: A plain Warden's longsword, pitted by years in the ground and still sharp.
wardens_grave_blade.lore: Every Warden's blade is stamped with the year of their oath. This one has been in the sand a great deal longer than the Wardens have kept these roads.

venomfang_dagger.name: Venomfang Dagger
venomfang_dagger.description: A curved dagger made from a spider's fang, still faintly wet at the tip.

bandit_captains_vest.name: Captain's Studded Vest
bandit_captains_vest.description: A leather vest studded with old coins, hammered flat, to stop a blade.

coinhand_signet.name: Coinhand's Signet Ring
coinhand_signet.description: A fat brass ring with a merchant's seal filed half off. Whoever wore it wanted to be someone else.

chieftains_bone_charm.name: Chieftain's Bone Charm
chieftains_bone_charm.description: A charm strung with knuckle bones, some of them too big to be goblin.

goblin_hide_boots.name: Goblin-Hide Boots
goblin_hide_boots.description: Boots sewn from goblin hide. They smell like it and they last.

tarnished_warden_helm.name: Tarnished Warden's Helm
tarnished_warden_helm.description: A dented Warden's helm, black with tarnish, the sacred flame on its brow almost worn away.

weavemothers_silk_cloak.name: Weavemother's Silk Cloak
weavemothers_silk_cloak.description: A cloak of pale silk that catches light like water. It weighs nothing and it does not tear.

wardens_tarnished_medal.name: Sergeant Halvek's Medal
wardens_tarnished_medal.description: A Warden's service medal, green with age. The name on the back is worn, but you can read it: HALVEK.
wardens_tarnished_medal.lore: Wardens are buried with their medals. Someone in Lumora will want to know this one is not in its grave.

lumoran_strongbox.name: Lumoran Strongbox
lumoran_strongbox.description: A small iron-banded strongbox stamped with the seal of a Lumoran trading house. The lock has been forced and forced shut again.
lumoran_strongbox.lore: Taken from a wagon on the south road. Whoever wants it back will want it back with the seal unbroken.

blighted_spider_silk.name: Blighted Spider Silk
blighted_spider_silk.description: A hank of grey silk that is warm to the touch, and should not be. There is a faint purple sheen in it.
blighted_spider_silk.lore: Healthy silk is cold and dry. This has been fed on something.

moribund_sigil.name: Moribund Sigil
moribund_sigil.description: A palm-sized disc of black stone carved with a closed eye above three drops. It is cold enough to hurt.
moribund_sigil.lore: Not spider work. The Order marks what it has claimed.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.description: Bent, salvageable bits of metal — buckles, blades, fittings. Useful for tinkering.

cog_trinket.name: Tinkered Cog Trinket
cog_trinket.description: A fitted brass cog on a cord, tuned and re-tuned until it stopped needing to be. Tobble Cogfarrow's first finished design.

basic_tinkering_kit.name: Basic Tinkering Kit
basic_tinkering_kit.description: A small satchel of gnomish hand tools. Right-click to open and assemble scrap into something useful.

scorpion_leg.name: Scorpion Leg
scorpion_leg.description: A jointed, bristled leg from a sand stinger.

stinger_tail.name: Stinger Tail
stinger_tail.description: A sand stinger's tail, the venom barb still attached. Handle with care.

toxic_residue.name: Toxic Residue
toxic_residue.description: A sticky, foul-smelling residue scraped from a sand stinger's venom sac. Alchemists pay for it.

scorpion_carapace.name: Scorpion Carapace
scorpion_carapace.description: A curved plate of sand stinger shell, hard as horn.

mangled_ear.name: Mangled Ear
mangled_ear.description: A torn ear from a wild dog. Proof of the kill, and not much else.

sharp_canine.name: Sharp Canine
sharp_canine.description: A long, yellowed fang from a wild dog.

chewed_bone.name: Chewed Bone
chewed_bone.description: A bone gnawed smooth. Best not to wonder what it came from.

small_map.name: Small Map
small_map.description: A scout's hand-drawn map of the plateau trails, marked with symbols you don't recognise.

light_leather.name: Light Leather
light_leather.description: A cured sheet of thin, supple leather. Useful to a leatherworker.

worn_sandals.name: Worn Sandals
worn_sandals.description: Desert sandals worn thin by long patrols.

leather_canteen.name: Leather Canteen
leather_canteen.description: An empty leather canteen, stitched and sealed with pitch.

scout_whistle.name: Scout Whistle
scout_whistle.description: A carved bone whistle that shrills like a hawk. Dustwalker scouts use them to signal.

sharp_dagger.name: Sharp Dagger
sharp_dagger.description: A well-kept dagger with a keen, freshly honed edge.

heavy_leather.name: Heavy Leather
heavy_leather.description: A thick, stiff hide, cured hard. Useful to a leatherworker.

ravager_earring.name: Ravager Earring
ravager_earring.description: A crude iron hoop, taken from a Dustwalker ravager.

notched_blade.name: Notched Blade
notched_blade.description: A heavy blade, its edge notched from hard use. It still bites.

combat_wraps.name: Combat Wraps
combat_wraps.description: Hard leather wraps bound over the knuckles, stained from many fights.

small_tin_cup.name: Small Tin Cup
small_tin_cup.description: A dented tin cup, rattling with sand.

lock_of_hair.name: Lock of Hair
lock_of_hair.description: A lock of hair tied with faded ribbon. Someone kept it close for a long time.

tough_hide.name: Tough Hide
tough_hide.description: A thick, scaly hide from a thornback lizard.

sharp_spine.name: Sharp Spine
sharp_spine.description: A needle-sharp spine plucked from a thornback lizard's back.

thorned_scale.name: Thorned Scale
thorned_scale.description: A hard scale ridged with small thorns.

lizard_tail.name: Lizard Tail
lizard_tail.description: A thornback lizard's tail. Still twitches, now and then.

desert_root.name: Desert Root
desert_root.description: A bitter, fibrous root dug up by lizards. Some healers brew it.

shifting_sand.name: Shifting Sand
shifting_sand.description: A handful of sand that won't stay still in your palm.

desert_essence.name: Desert Essence
desert_essence.description: A swirling mote of the desert's heat, bottled. A rare reagent.

elemental_core_fragment.name: Elemental Core Fragment
elemental_core_fragment.description: A warm shard from the heart of a sandshifter. It pulses faintly.

sand_vial.name: Sand Vial
sand_vial.description: A stoppered vial of fine, glittering sand from a sandshifter.

heavy_chitin.name: Heavy Chitin
heavy_chitin.description: A thick plate of khepri beetle shell.

gilded_wing.name: Gilded Wing
gilded_wing.description: A khepri beetle's wing case, shining like beaten gold. Jewelers prize it.

stable_key.name: Stable Key
stable_key.description: An iron key stamped with the Lumora stables' mark.

outrider_insignia.name: Outrider Insignia
outrider_insignia.description: A tarnished badge worn by Lumora's outriders.

standard_issue_spear.name: Standard-Issue Spear
standard_issue_spear.description: A plain, sturdy spear, the kind Lumora hands its outriders.

jeweled_hilt.name: Jeweled Hilt
jeweled_hilt.description: The hilt of a broken sword, set with small, dusty gems. Worth something to the right buyer.

conqueror_map.name: Conqueror's Map
conqueror_map.description: A war map of the plateaus, the Dustwalker warlord's raids marked in red.

royal_sandals.name: Royal Sandals
royal_sandals.description: Fine sandals with gilded straps, taken from a warlord who took them from someone else.
